name: Soul Salve
description: Lay a cool palm over an ally's brow and spread a thin film of soul force that eases a bruised soul.

name: Hushed Mend
description: Hum a low steady note beside an ally while soul force knits a small tear in the ally's soul.

name: Pale Lantern
description: Raise a small glow of soul force and read its flicker to learn how deeply a patient's soul is hurt.

name: Warding Hush
description: Draw a quiet veil of soul force over a hurt ally so a second soul strike cannot reach the wound.

name: Steady Ember
description: Feed a tired ally a slow warmth of soul force until the ally's clouded focus clears.

name: Thread Rest
description: Pull one fine thread of soul force through a frayed place in an ally's soul until the strands lie smooth.

name: Kindly Touch
description: Rest two fingers at an ally's breastbone and pass in soul force that closes a small scrape of the soul.

name: Fray Easing
description: Stroke along the edge of a frayed soul with slow soul force until the fraying stops spreading in the ally.

name: Dimness Scan
description: Hold a hand near a patient and judge the dimness of the soul's glow to find where it has been struck.

name: Spirit Cradle
description: Wrap a hurt ally's soul in a cradle of soft force that blunts every jolt while the healing proceeds.

name: Metered Breath
description: Match an ally's breathing to a slow count and send soul force along it until the ally's thoughts settle.

name: Bruise Lull
description: Press the heel of the hand to the spot where a soul feels bruised and draw the ache out of the ally.

name: Quiet Press
description: Hold a steady pressure of soul force on a fresh soul wound until the bleeding of spirit slows in the ally.

name: Single Thread
description: Draw one fine thread of soul force across a small tear so the edges of an ally's soul meet.

name: Seam Pinch
description: Run soul force along an open seam in an ally's soul and pinch it shut a finger's width at a time.

name: Strand Tally
description: Pass a feeler of soul force over a patient's soul and count the broken strands to know the damage.

name: Lacing Guard
description: Lace a quick mesh of soul force over a mended place so a stray strike cannot tear it open again.

name: Needle Calm
description: Steady the sewing hand and the patient's breath together so the thread of soul force goes in cleanly on an ally.

name: Tether Knot
description: Tie off a mended thread with a knot of soul force so an ally's repaired soul keeps its strength.

name: Stitch Pause
description: Hold a tearing soul still with one firm touch of soul force so a deeper rip does not open in the ally.

name: Fine Stitch
description: Set one small stitch of soul force across a clean break in an ally's soul and draw it snug.

name: Running Stitch
description: Sew a long steady line of soul force along a wide break until the ally's soul is joined from end to end.

name: Edge Hold
description: Pin the lips of a fresh soul wound shut with soul force so grit of spirit cannot enter the ally.

name: Stitch Check
description: Tap each finished stitch with a pulse of soul force and feel which ones still hold in the patient.

name: Cross Weave
description: Weave soul force crosswise over a wound in an ally's soul so the patch bears strain from every side.

name: Wound Hush
description: Breathe a cooling pulse of soul force over a stinging soul wound until the ally stops flinching.

name: Knot Steady
description: Hold a patient's attention on one calm point while soul force firms the repaired soul around it.

name: Bedside Warmth
description: Sit beside a sleeper and let soul force warm the soul slowly until the chill of a blow leaves the ally.

name: Watchful Glow
description: Keep a faint glow of soul force over a patient and note every flutter of the soul through the night.

name: Light Dabbing
description: Dab a light salve of soul force on a sore spot of the soul so the ally can rest.

name: Close Ward
description: Hold a close shell of soul force around a sleeping patient so a stray strike of spirit slides off.

name: Settled Mind
description: Ease a patient's racing thoughts with soul force until the ally wakes clear and steady.

name: Calming Current
description: Send a slow current of soul force through an ally in fright until the shaking of the spirit stops.

name: Fever Cooling
description: Draw the heat of a spirit fever out of an ally with cool strokes of soul force along the spine.

name: Tide Reading
description: Feel the rise and fall of a patient's soul current to learn whether it runs too fast or too slow.

name: Slow Eddy
description: Turn a wild soul current into a slow eddy with patient soul force until the ally's spirit stills.

name: Levee Calm
description: Bank the ally's soul current behind a low wall of force so a sudden shock cannot flood it.

name: Steadied Pulse
description: Tap a steady beat of soul force against an ally's heart until it falls into the same even rhythm.

name: Gentle Ebb
description: Let the ache of a struck soul drain away through the healer's palm and out of the ally.

name: Mending Glow
description: Let the healer's own soul glow brighten over an ally's wound until the broken places fill in.

name: Glow Shaping
description: Shape the glow of the soul into a narrow beam so the healing lands only where an ally needs it.

name: Dim Spot
description: Pass the glow across a patient and mark every place where the light of the soul falls dim.

name: Glow Mantle
description: Spread a soft mantle of glow over a hurt ally so the mended soul is not struck again.

name: Warm Seep
description: Let warmth of soul force seep slowly into a cold numbed soul until feeling returns to the ally.

name: Bright Rinse
description: Flush a smear of spirit grime from an ally's soul with one bright pulse of the healer's glow.

name: Wisp Balm
description: Brush the new wisp of soul over an ally's bruise and leave a light balm that numbs the hurt.

name: Early Hush
description: Hold a frightened ally's hand and let the small young soul force settle the shaking of the spirit.

name: First Sight
description: Open the new soul sense a crack and feel whether a patient's soul has been struck or only shaken.

name: Slender Veil
description: Cast a slender veil of young soul force over a hurt ally so a small strike glances away.

name: Tender Spark
description: Feed a weary ally a tender spark of soul force until the ally's will steadies.

name: Light Suture
description: Close a hairline break in an ally's soul with a single light suture of the young soul.

name: Patient Wick
description: Trim and tend a flickering soul like a wick so its light returns slowly in the ally.
